mapper.select: SELECT id, role_code, role_name, role_type, description, status, created_at FROM schema_common.sys_role WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, role_code, role_name, role_type, description, status, created_at FROM schema_common.sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
SELECT id, role_code, role_name, role_type, description, status, created_at FROM schema_common.sys_role ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, role_id, module, permissions FROM schema_common.sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_common.sys_role (role_code, role_name, role_type, description, status) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{roleType}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1))
INSERT INTO schema_common.sys_role_permission (role_id, module, permissions) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{module}, CAST(#{permissions, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
